newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen adding reserves via overnight system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen adding reserves via overnight system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve Bank of New York is expected to add temporary reserves to the banking system on Wednesday via overnight system repurchase agreements, Wall Street Fed watchers said.
"To end the first week of the current (reserve maintenance) period, we're looking for an overnight system RP," said Dana Saporta, economist at Stone & McCarthy Research Associates Inc.
Saporta also said the forecast operation is expected to be small to moderate in size, "maybe $2.0 or $3.0 billion."
Analysts at consulting firm MMS International Inc are also expecting the Fed to inject reserves into the system through a system repurchase operation.
Saporta estimated the Fed will be facing a daily average add need of around $9.0 billion in the remaining eight days of the current two-week reserve maintenance period.
At 0930 EST/1430 GMT, federal funds were quoted at 5-1/4 percent, in line with the central bank's target for the rate.
